# Curated release env set for release.yml (epic #14 / T3 / #17).
# One PlatformIO env per line. Lines starting with # and blank lines are ignored.
# 85 active envs; verified against variants/*/platformio.ini. GATED (CI-built,
# not released): heltec_v4_repeater_telemetry (#20, runtime-config secrets) and
# the three companion_radio_wifi envs (#325, runtime WiFi provisioning) -- all
# bake placeholder creds at compile time; uncomment when their gate issue lands.

# Heltec RadioCore RC32-L62 (ESP32-S3 + HT-RA62A LoRa) -- #771
# Applies to the L62 (LoRa) carrier only. RC32-68 carries the HT-HC01_V2 Wi-Fi
# HaLow module on a DIFFERENT pinout and has no variant in this tree.
# heltec_rc32_companion_radio_wifi -- NOT releasable: bakes a placeholder
#   WIFI_SSID at compile time; unblocked by #325. Same gate class as the other
#   companion_radio_wifi envs. (Unlike those, it is not CI-built either -- no
#   rc32 env is in ci.yml yet; tracked separately.)
# The older _diag / _diag_nocrashlog envs are bench instruments, not products,
# and stay out. The _testdiag envs below are different -- see the note after.
heltec_rc32_companion_radio_ble
heltec_rc32_companion_radio_usb
heltec_rc32_repeater
heltec_rc32_room_server

# RC32 TESTER DIAGNOSTIC BUILDS -- published on EVERY release while RadioCore is
# unreleased hardware (owner decision, 2026-08-18).
#
# Each EXTENDS the shipped env above and adds ONLY OFFBAND_BOOT_BEACON and
# OFFBAND_MESHLOG_UART0. Nothing else differs. That is deliberate: a diagnostic
# build that diverges from the shipped build diagnoses the wrong firmware, which
# is exactly how the GPS-on-a-strapping-pin defect (#704) survived every bench
# session -- every result came from a build that had already worked around it.
#
# Why they ship rather than being built by hand: a beta tester whose board will
# not boot cannot reach a CLI, and hand-packaged binaries go stale the moment
# firmware-base moves. Publishing them per-release keeps them current for free.
#
# Reading their output needs an external UART sniffer on RC32 pin 12 (U0TXD) and
# pin 20 (GND) -- see tools/diag/rc32-tester/.
#
# REVISIT when RadioCore ships as released hardware, and when #763 lands its
# level gate: the UART0 mirror is a synchronous bounded busy-wait, and combining
# it with debug-level logging hangs setup() (2 s -> 118 s -> never). These envs
# do not enable debug logging, so they are safe as built -- but the hazard is why
# this is scoped to unreleased hardware rather than made a general pattern.
heltec_rc32_companion_radio_ble_testdiag
heltec_rc32_companion_radio_usb_testdiag
heltec_rc32_repeater_testdiag
